name: agent-discipline
description: Another Agent Skills - Agent Discipline Hooks for Cursor
note: Packaging manifest. Cursor's documented runtime hook config is `.cursor/hooks.json` (project) or `~/.cursor/hooks.json` (user); event names follow cursor.com/docs/hooks (beforeShellExecution). failClosed:true blocks on crash/timeout/non-zero exit for the security-critical commit-approval guard. The jq-missing path is intentionally fail-open (best-effort gate, mirrors the Claude hook) and logs a visible warning — see the hook's header. commit-approval.sh denies git mutations unconditionally (philosophy A, no token bypass).
